name: @red-cup-engineering/relation-model-notation-reader
description: RMN's JSON boundary codec and named-variable surface syntax: isRelationalTerm/parseRmn/settleRmn are the closed-well-typed-term admission gate; extractRelationalScripts/htmlIsRelational/settleRelationalHtml and sessionIsRelational/settleRelationalSession extend that gate to <script type="application/rmn+json"> HTML documents and message-stream sessions; compileNamedRmn/parseNamedRmn and namedString/namedArray/namedObject/namedBool/namedGenerator admit a named-variable surface (resolved to de-Bruijn indices by ordinary lexical shadowing, innermost binder wins) and compile it to the closed kernel, with namedOfCompiled/canonicalNamedRmn/digestNamedRmn as the reverse direction.
